desc: Parse input: read N and the N×N character grid; build adjacency structures, including for each vertex v and letter c the list of in-neighbors (x with edge x→v labeled c) and out-neighbors.
Initialize distance matrix dist[N][N] with -1; set dist[i][i]=0 and dist[i][j]=1 for each existing edge i→j; enqueue all these states into a BFS deque.
Run BFS: pop state (u, v) with distance d; for each letter c, for each in-neighbor x of u via c and out-neighbor y of v via c, if dist[x][y] is unset, set it to d+2 and enqueue (x, y).
Output the N×N dist matrix in the required space-separated format with rows per line.

Verify the solution's correctness and performance: trace through both sample inputs by hand (or mentally simulate) to confirm outputs match, check edge cases (N=1, self-loops, unreachable pairs), and assess worst-case runtime for N=100 dense single-label graphs; optimize with bitsets if needed.
